Chu ky co kiem soat xung dot loi ich: domains/cncl_match/nguoi_ky.yaml (nguoi ky + don vi lien quan + so nguoi ky toi thieu), cong xung_dot_ky (NGUOI_KY_LA, KY_XUNG_DOT, THIEU_CHU_KY) + 4 rang; hien tai 0 vi pham, nguoi gac cong khong ky duoc cap co RtR; nang so toi thieu len 2 la bat luat hai nguoi ky. Trang Phuong phap giai thich.

Tinh nang Ho so kiem toan duoc: moi ho so don vi co ma SHA-256 (lib/kiem-toan.mjs) cua cau nguon nguyen van + dau vet ban chup, nut tai tep JSON, cong cu doi chieu cho nguoi nhan (scripts/kiem-ho-so.mjs: KHOP/LECH, --ban-chup soi tung ban chup). Cong kiem_toan (KIEM_TOAN_LECH, BAN_CHUP_THIEU, DOI_CHIEU_HONG dau cuoi) + 5 rang.

Tinh nang Bao cao khoang trong (/dashboard/bao-cao): bao cao dinh ky theo quy, in hoac luu PDF, sinh tu dong tu thi truong + mo dau + lich su git (lib/bao-cao.mjs): tom tat, 30 san pham va trang thai, san pham chi mot ben cung, nhom can uu tien, do tin cay so lieu, viec tiep. Cong bao_cao (BAO_CAO_LECH, SO_LECH dem doc lap tu registry/match/do thi, KY_SAI) + 4 rang. Nav them muc; truy cap quet them trang; chup_xem them anh.

Lo 03 cau that (BAN NHAP, cho anh Lam duyet): 54 nhu cau dat hang cong nghe co nguon sau khi gop 6 cap trung (10 nhiem vu KH&CN dat hang cua Bo KH&CN, 19 bai toan lon Ha Noi/Bo Cong an/Bo Cong Thuong/Da Nang, 20 nhiem vu chuong trinh QD 808 va QD 2815, 5 du an goi thau), 34 honest-null; doi chieu doc lap 128/131 khop (3 chua tai lai duoc). Cong kiem_lo_cau.py (13 luat, gop trung bat buoc khai) + 11 rang; kiem_lo --tat-ca re nhanh LOAI_CAU. Bang duyet kem xem truoc don vi lien quan bang chinh may hoi dap (41/54 nhu cau da co don vi trong so nguon).

Tinh nang Hoi dap co nguon (/dashboard/hoi-dap): hoi bang tieng Viet, tra loi bang cau nguon nguyen van chon bang truy hoi tat dinh (lib/hoi-dap.mjs: khai niem + dong nghia + tu ghep tu kho cum tu cua so nguon, nguong theo trong so), kem cap ghep da ky cho nhu cau duoc hoi, to dam tu khop, lien ket ?q=. Khong sinh chu; khong co nguon thi tu choi. Cong hoi_dap (CHI_MUC_LECH, TRICH_BIA, TRICH_LAC_DE, TU_CHOI_SAI, KHONG_TU_CHOI, CAU_CHUAN_HONG, DON_VI_LA) chay bo 14 cau chuan + 6 rang. Truy cap quet them 2 trang; chup_man buoc 4c chup anh xem. Can chay chup_man tren may that de lam moi truy_cap va anh moc.
